programs.title: Cut Bank
programs.desc: (2014) Moody crime thriller with Liam Hemsworth, John Malkovich and Billy Bob Thornton. Could capturing a crime on camera be a couple's ticket out of Cut Bank? Escaping a small town can be murder...

programs.title: Killer In My Home
programs.desc: (2020) Sinister thriller starring Bree Williamson. Allison's world falls apart when her husband dies suddenly. But then his secret family turn up, who have everything but good intentions...

programs.title: Predestination
programs.desc: (2015) Sci-fi action with Ethan Hawke and Succession's Sarah Snook. A temporal agent who stops crimes before they happen is tasked with catching a fugitive who's always one step ahead in time.

programs.title: Lone Rider
programs.desc: (2008) Gutsy western starring Lou Diamond Phillips. A decorated soldier returning home after the American Civil War finds that an evil land owner has taken over the town.

programs.title: The Quick And The Dead
programs.desc: (1963) War drama starring Victor French and Majel Barrett. With the aid of local partisans, a group of American soldiers try to make it through enemy-occupied Italy to safety.
